doc.title: Michael Max Fleming interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017

title: Alternative career: his father the politician
summary: His father was a politician who hoped Fleming would become a lawyer or politician, but music won out.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well we’ve talked for over an hour here.
I enjoy your outlook and your positive attitude. If you hadn’t become a musician did you have a second interest? Could you imagine doing anything else?

My father was a politician. Election Day was a big day at my place. I sat on the knees of ambassadors. My father was in contact with senators and presidents and vice-presidents. And I think in his heart that’s what he wanted me to do. But there was something about him where he couldn’t force it on me. But that’s what he really wanted. Like if you are a three-year-old, and he says, “Hello young man, how are you, how are you doing, what are you going to do when you grow up? What are you going to be?” “A lawyer.” Just a little baby. That’s the way I was groomed. Is that strange?
Well I’m glad the music won out personally.
